title: The Lamb and the Knot
lines: Jen has a small lamb that likes to climb.
It got up on a rock and got stuck.
A knot of rope was caught on its leg.
Jen fell on one knee to reach the lamb.
She had to wrap her thumb in a rag.
At last the knot came free.
Now Jen knows where to keep her rope.

questions.ask: Where did the lamb get stuck?
questions.listenFor: Up on a rock. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: What was caught on the lamb's leg?
questions.listenFor: A knot of rope. Ask how Jen got it off.

questions.ask: What do you think Jen will do with the rope now? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. The last line gives a clue.
